The old-caption regression log demonstrates the actual width expansion in the same unit-event harness, while the changed caption passes. The I61/N5 lease changes are exactly three app-tree pin updates and do not alter scenario assertions. The staged app source tree hashes to the requested candidate 6ea8f033c5241781e895ecb54af3bb3b48bb0735. Historical I61/N5 results on fe405... do not transfer; full native runs on the new tree remain mandatory.
